title: Sherman on affecting the sine wave at will
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Sherman on affecting the sine wave at will, about 1990s at NSA complex, Maryland, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> I could definitely affect the the motion and I could do it just at will.

plain: A man named Dan Sherman, who says he was drawn into a secret UFO programme as a child, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about tests in the 1990s at a complex of the NSA, the US government's signals intelligence agency, in Maryland. Sherman says he was shown a sine wave, a smooth repeating wave line, and that he could change its motion with his mind, just at will. If true, it would mean a person's mind can directly affect a machine's signal.
